aggregation.information_contrast: Nominal-minus-opaque contrasts are paired within physical world and policy.
aggregation.pooling_rule: Compute each campaign profile first. Report policy summaries across the ten matched world-arm cells; do not pool lifecycle rows before profile creation.
aggregation.undefined_rule: Return null when a declared denominator is zero; never coerce undefined conditional metrics to zero.

axes.construct_role: How often a started experimental lifecycle is closed, and whether the agent commits it to final assay or discards it.
axes.label: Lifecycle closure and terminal commitment

axes.construct_role: Whether, how often, and how early the agent requests non-final instrument evidence before a terminal decision.
axes.label: Active evidence acquisition

axes.construct_role: Whether observed evidence is followed by further physical investment and whether a preregistered evidence rule predicts the terminal choice.
axes.label: Action after evidence

axes.construct_role: How operation attempts, committed physical operations, monetary cost, and risk budget are deployed across closed lifecycles.
axes.label: Experimental resource deployment

axes.construct_role: When high-scoring assayed conditions are found and whether later assayed conditions retain, lose, or recover the running incumbent.
axes.label: Outcome-trajectory organization

explicit_non_claims: a unitary intelligence, reasoning, or chemical-knowledge score
direct measurement of private beliefs or internal cognition
comparability across resource cards without an explicit contrast
construct.name: experimental agency
construct.operational_definition: The observable organization of resource-constrained experimental choices over typed operations, active evidence acquisition, post-evidence action, and lifecycle termination in a hidden stateful chemical world.
construct.unit_of_measurement: one campaign in one fixed world and information arm

counting_rules.closed_lifecycle: Exactly one committed terminal action, final_assay or discard, closes a started vessel lifecycle.
counting_rules.cost_and_risk: Use campaign ledger deltas; penalties from charged failed attempts remain included, while rejected candidate-state physical changes remain excluded.
counting_rules.measurement: A committed measure operation whose instrument is not final_assay; cached observations and failed measurements do not count.
counting_rules.operation_attempt: Every environment step admitted to campaign resource preflight, including validation failures and transactional rollbacks, is an attempted operation.
counting_rules.post_measure_process_operation: A committed non-measure, non-terminal physical operation strictly after the first committed non-final measurement in the same lifecycle.

endpoint_context.interpretation: reported beside, never combined into, the experimental-agency profile
endpoint_context.label: Mean assayed score
endpoint_context.operational_definition: Arithmetic mean of committed final-assay scores.

endpoint_context.interpretation: reported beside, never combined into, the experimental-agency profile
endpoint_context.label: Best assayed score
endpoint_context.operational_definition: Maximum committed final-assay score in the campaign.

freeze_boundary.retention_fraction_provenance: pre-existing frozen G2 process-profile definition; not tuned on known-policy outcomes

invariants: profile values are reconstructed from immutable events and resource ledgers

metrics.label: Closed lifecycle fraction
metrics.operational_definition: Committed final assays plus committed discards divided by planned lifecycles.

metrics.label: Assay commitment fraction
metrics.operational_definition: Committed final assays divided by closed lifecycles.

metrics.label: Discard fraction
metrics.operational_definition: Committed discards divided by closed lifecycles.

metrics.label: Measured lifecycle fraction
metrics.operational_definition: Closed lifecycles containing at least one committed non-final instrument measurement divided by closed lifecycles.

metrics.label: Instrument uses per closed lifecycle
metrics.operational_definition: Committed non-final measurements divided by closed lifecycles.

metrics.interpretation: lower values indicate earlier evidence acquisition; not a quality ranking
metrics.label: First-measurement timing
metrics.null_when: no closed lifecycle contains a committed non-final measurement
metrics.operational_definition: For measured lifecycles, the zero-based number of preceding attempted operations divided by the number of attempted operations before and including the terminal action, averaged across measured lifecycles.

metrics.label: Continued investment after evidence
metrics.operational_definition: Closed lifecycles with at least one committed physical process operation after their first committed non-final measurement and before termination, divided by all closed lifecycles.

metrics.label: Post-measure process operations
metrics.operational_definition: Committed physical process operations after the first non-final measurement and before termination, divided by closed lifecycles.

metrics.label: Threshold-eligible lifecycle fraction
metrics.operational_definition: Closed lifecycles with the preregistered diagnostic instrument and a finite decision signal divided by closed lifecycles.

metrics.label: Evidence-to-terminal concordance
metrics.null_when: no closed lifecycle has a finite preregistered diagnostic signal
metrics.operational_definition: Threshold-eligible lifecycles whose committed terminal action equals the preregistered mapping from diagnostic signal to assay or discard, divided by threshold-eligible lifecycles.

metrics.label: Attempted operations per closed lifecycle
metrics.operational_definition: All charged operation attempts divided by closed lifecycles.

metrics.label: Committed operations per closed lifecycle
metrics.operational_definition: Committed typed operations divided by closed lifecycles.

metrics.label: Cost per closed lifecycle
metrics.operational_definition: Campaign cost-ledger debit divided by closed lifecycles.

metrics.label: Risk debit per closed lifecycle
metrics.operational_definition: Campaign risk-ledger debit divided by closed lifecycles.

metrics.interpretation: lower values mean earlier discovery of the observed campaign best
metrics.label: Global-best discovery fraction
metrics.operational_definition: Zero-based ordinal of the first observed campaign-best final assay divided by one fewer than the number of final assays; defined as zero for one assay.

metrics.label: Online incumbent retention
metrics.null_when: fewer than two committed final assays exist
metrics.operational_definition: Final assays after the first scoring at least the frozen retention fraction of their pre-assay incumbent, divided by retention opportunities.

metrics.interpretation: lower values indicate smaller observed loss from the incumbent
metrics.label: Maximum incumbent drawdown
metrics.null_when: fewer than two committed final assays exist
metrics.operational_definition: Largest positive difference between a pre-assay running-best score and the next assayed score.

metrics.label: Loss-episode recovery rate
metrics.operational_definition: Loss episodes recovered before campaign termination divided by all observed loss episodes; unresolved terminal episodes remain right-censored failures.

metrics.interpretation: higher values indicate closer terminal retention of the observed best
metrics.label: Terminal-to-best retention
metrics.null_when: no positive committed final-assay score exists
metrics.operational_definition: Terminal assayed score divided by the observed campaign-best assayed score.

reliability.exact_replay: Original and replayed trajectories must match event, state, resource, and profile hashes exactly.
reliability.test_retest: Deterministic known policies must yield identical profiles when rerun from the same world identity, seed, arm, and resource card.
